questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.

questions.question:

The health personnel advised to ________ of unhealthy food habits if we want to maintain our cardio-vascular health.
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **Steer clear.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is: **steer clear.**
 
• The idiom** "steer clear" **means to avoid or stay away from something. In the given context, the health personnel is advising against unhealthy food habits to maintain cardio-vascular health.
